risk_if_not_implemented: Without Coordinated Testing with Related Plans, critical business processes and services may not withstand or recover from disruption, causing extended outages and data loss. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unperformed / Unowned Control Responsibilities (R-GV-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25).

compensating_control_1.name: Contingency Plan Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Lessons Learned
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and "lessons learned" activity every time the contingency plan is activated.
compensating_control_1.justification: Contingency Plan Root Cause Analysis (RCA) & Lessons Learned (BCD-11) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Coordinated Testing with Related Plans (BCD-10.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Contingency Plan Testing & Exercises
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct tests and/or exercises to evaluate the contingency plan's effectiveness and the organization's readiness to execute the plan.
compensating_control_2.justification: Contingency Plan Testing & Exercises (BCD-10) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Coordinated Testing with Related Plans (BCD-10.1) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
